sections.name: File setup, ConsentModule
sections.title: Consent feature packaging
sections.what: Imports the database module, registers the consent controller and service, and exports the service for other features.
sections.why: Likely reason: standard NestJS grouping, with the export allowing the chat feature to check consent.
sections.watch_out: Removing the export would stop the chat feature from checking consent.

summary: Packages the consent feature so the app can load its controller and service, and lets other features use the consent service.
purpose: Tells NestJS which controller and service belong to consent, and makes the service available to other modules.
why: Likely reason: standard NestJS grouping, plus an export so the chat feature can check consent.
how: 1. Imports the database module. 2. Registers the consent controller and service. 3. Exports the service for other modules.
outputs: A module object loaded at startup.
risks: If the database module is missing, the consent service cannot run. Other modules depend on the export, so removing it would break the chat feature.
debug: Look for startup errors naming a missing provider. Check that the chat module can still load.
